name: Outline
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: For plans, to-dos and outlines: a clean sans on a cool white page, headings that change colour by level, pink bold and teal quotes, and roomy list items. Colours after Things, our own CSS.

zh.description: 适合计划、待办和大纲：冷白底上的简洁无衬线字体，标题按级别换色，粉色粗体、青绿引用，列表项留白宽松。配色参考 Things，CSS 为我们自己编写。
